issues.description: Animal API visibility is inconsistent: the UML and task text specify Animal's constructor, getName(), and setName(String) as protected (# / "protected visibility"), but the solution implements them as public. This can mislead students about required encapsulation and may not match tests that enforce protected access.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution match the specification by changing Animal's constructor, getName(), and setName(String) to protected (and adjust any external usage accordingly), or update the UML/text to explicitly require public visibility if that is intended.

issues.description: Farm.singFarmSongVerse signature differs between template and spec/solution: the template declares `private void singFarmSongVerse(/*Animal animal*/)` (no usable parameter), while the UML/spec and solution require `private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)`. This forces students to refactor the provided stub before implementing the required behavior.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template to `private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)` (and ensure Animal is in scope via import or same package), matching the UML/spec and solution.
